# `assert_true`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Throws an exception if `expr` is not true.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
assert_true(expr [, message])
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `misc_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- assert_true, example 1
> SELECT assert_true(0 < 1);
NULL
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 2.0.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
